user.title: Jow
user.description: No credentials needed for recipes. The Jow refresh token (optional) syncs allergies and preferences from your account.

errors.invalid_format: Token does not match the expected JWT format (3 segments). Copy the refreshToken value from jow.fr (F12 → Console → localStorage).
errors.corrupted: Token unreadable (likely truncated or altered while copy-pasting). Copy it again in full — use copy() from the Chrome console to avoid alteration.
errors.wrong_type: You pasted an access token (valid 48 h) instead of the refresh token (~6 months). Use the refreshToken field value.
